text: Solverde.pt is run by Solverde - Sociedade de Investimentos Turísticos da Costa Verde, S.A., which operates online games and betting through www.solverde.pt. The Solverde group is wholly held by Violas SGPS, the family holding controlled in equal parts by the siblings Manuel and Rita Celeste.
short: Grupo Solverde is wholly held by Violas SGPS, the Violas family holding.
